lines.en: What do you do at noon nowadays?
I water the garden at midday. Then I rest.
lines.ko: 한낮에 정원에 물을 줘요. 그다음에 쉬어요.

lines.en: You look stronger lately.
Thank you. These days I walk every weekday.
Did you walk last weekend too?
No. Last weekend I rested and read a book.
lines.ko: 아니요. 지난 주말에는 쉬면서 책을 읽었어요.

lines.en: Can we walk together later today?
Of course. I am ready after lunch.
Someday we will walk to the mountain.
Yes! I will remember this day forever.

dialogs.about: 병원에서 의사에게 요즘 몸 상태를 이야기해요

lines.en: Good morning. How do you feel lately?
Good morning, Doctor. I sleep quite well now.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 선생님. 요즘 잠을 꽤 잘 자요.

lines.en: Wonderful. Do you eat lunch around noon?
Yes. I eat at midday and walk afterwards.
That is very good for your health.
My knee hurt last weekend after the rain.
lines.ko: 지난 주말에 비 온 뒤에 무릎이 아팠어요.

lines.en: Did it start recently?
Yes, two weeks ago. It's much better now.
lines.ko: 네, 두 주 전에요. 지금은 훨씬 나아요.

lines.en: Good. Someday the pain will go away.
Thank you, Doctor. I will walk every weekday.
